subject: Request: Startup Academy cohort credits — scaling & expiry options
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@startupacademy.org>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: cohort credit scaling + expiration flexibility

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the last cohort — the students loved the latency and the free credits helped them get started. We ran the usage numbers (attached) and we have ~120k unused credit units left from the Founders Cohort package that will expire at the end of January.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood extend the expiry on those remaining credits to 12 months? Our next cohort schedule just shifted and we need the runway.
- Alternatively, would you convert a portion of the unused credits into a short-term committed discount (e.g., 3 months reserved capacity) in exchange for additional promotional credits for the next 2 cohorts?

We have a constrained program budget; a longer expiry would be ideal but we can consider the commit if it comes with bonus credits or a favorable rate. If conversion/extension requires an exception, please let us know what you need from our procurement team.

I attached a short usage summary and cohort projection. Can we schedule a 30-min call early next week? Our finance contact (finance@startupacademy.org) should be on the thread for PO/invoice if we move forward.

Thanks,
Asha Rao
Program Director, Startup Academy
startupacademy.org

Attachment: cohort_usage_summary.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: Asha Rao <asha@startupacademy.org>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 13:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: cohort credit scaling + expiration flexibility

Hi Asha — great to hear the cohort had good results, and thanks for the usage summary. Attaching a short options sheet but high-level we can do either:

Option A — One-time expiry extension
- Move remaining credits to a 12-month expiry window (one-time exception)
- No change to unit economics
- Requires VP sales approval (policy exception)

Option B — Convert into committed short-term capacity + bonus credits
- Commit to 3 months reserved capacity at a reduced per-token rate (we'd provide a proposal for committed qps and expected tokens/month)
- Redwood adds +25% bonus promotional credits to be used for the next 2 cohorts
- Requires a short MAA amendment and finance sign-off (we can generate a simple addendum)

If you can share expected peak tokens/month for the cohort and whether finance prefers an extension vs committed pricing, we’ll prepare a draft. I can also do a 30-min call — I’m available Mon/Tue 10–12 PT.

Looping in Rishi (sales leader) and Grace (growth) to flag this as a potential accelerator program exception. I’ll prepare a clean proposal once you confirm which direction you prefer.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive — Strategic Programs
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: accelerator_credit_options.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: Asha Rao <asha@startupacademy.org>
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Cc: finance@startupacademy.org
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 08:09:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: cohort credit scaling + expiration flexibility

Thanks, Lauren. Option B sounds promising — the bonus credits would really help our demo days. For the next cohort we expect ~250k tokens/month peak over a 6-week window, with ~75k tokens as steady baseline.

Finance asked for a ballpark $ estimate for Option B (committed 3 months with +25% bonus credits) so we can provision PO approval ahead of the call. We attached the cohort projection workbook with anticipated usage per team. Tuesday 11:00 AM PT works for us.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
— Asha

Attachment: cohort_projection.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)

From: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2026 11:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Startup Academy — credit request and projection (internal)

Folks — forwarding the thread and Asha’s projection. My recommended approach: approve Option B but with a slightly modified economics to protect unit revenue. Proposed structure:

- 3-month commit, conservative committed tokens: 180k tokens/month
- Discount off list per-token rate: 15%
- Bonus promotional credits: +25% of current unused credit pool (applied after commit activation)
- Addendum: one-time, non-recurring; credits expire 12 months after activation of the committed plan.

Rationale: we lock some guaranteed volume (downside protection) and still give the partner a visible uplift for cohort demos. We should not extend unlimited expiry policy-wide.

Need finance/ops sign-off for the discount and to confirm billing SOW (PO vs invoice). I attached a redlined proposal for quick review. If we greenlight this, I’ll send a concise MAA addendum for signature and the DocuSign link.

Quote from Asha’s original email for context: "we have ~120k unused credit units left from the Founders Cohort package that will expire at the end of January."

Thoughts?

— Lauren
Attachment: proposal_redlined.docx (DOCX, 45KB)"

From: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com, grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com, Asha Rao <asha@startupacademy.org>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 15:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Startup Academy cohort credits — scaling & expiry options

Thanks everyone — I’m OK to approve a one-off structure consistent with Lauren’s proposal with small edits: 1) make the committed floor 160k tokens/month (conservative), 2) discount 15% as proposed, 3) bonus credits set at +20% (instead of 25%) given this is an exception and we want to preserve runway for other cohorts.

Lauren — please prepare the MAA addendum with these terms and include: PO billing instructions, a 30-day payment window, and a clause that the bonus credits are non-transferable and expire 12 months after activation. Asha — I’ll authorize the exception once we have finance details (PO or billing email).

Next steps:
- Lauren to send draft addendum + DocuSign link (RDW-DEAL-86724)
- Asha/Finance to confirm PO or billing contact
- Once signed we’ll provision the committed capacity and apply bonus credits

Asha — thanks for working with us. If you want I can join the Tuesday call to speed approvals.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
